text: Ekadashi is the eleventh day, and our elders set it aside as a day to turn attention inward — away from appetite and towards remembrance.
The purpose was never the empty stomach; it was the quiet space it created for reflection.
You can chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' while doing your ordinary work, or read a few names from Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and take one still minute in front of it.
